# QnALog 1.7.3

A visual polish release, plus one fix for the floating button.

## Changed

- **Buttons show their intended colours.** Obsidian's default button style was overriding QnALog's on several buttons. Primary buttons on the recording-blocked overlay and the Ask panel's batch-write button now use the accent colour, and secondary buttons in the setup wizard, progress window and import dialog are transparent as designed.
- **Notes list.** On the topic-suggestion row, Integrate and Ignore are now text links on the same line as the hint instead of tall boxed buttons.
- **Ask panel.** Added spacing under the title; the focus ring now follows the rounded input.
- **Settings.** Section titles are larger than setting names, status rows use the same service names as the API tab, the audio input and prompt text boxes sit inside their cards, and toggle rows use the full width for their descriptions.
- **Sidebar.** Outline sections are evenly spaced, the append-recording button is flatter, and the empty "no outline" state has a title and a description.
- **Bases.** QnALog's card styling now applies only to QnALog's own Base files (the people base and files in the configured views folder). Other Bases in your vault keep Obsidian's default look.
- **Floating record buttons.** The last rows of the notes list and outline can scroll clear of the buttons when they are docked over the sidebar.
- **Text sizes follow Obsidian's font size setting** (Appearance, Font size). Some 9 to 10 px labels are now 11 px.

## Fixed

- Turning "Show floating button" back on from settings no longer requires restarting Obsidian. When settings open in a separate window (as in Obsidian 1.14), the button was created in that window and disappeared when settings closed.

## User impact

- The settings schema version is unchanged. No settings are dropped or changed by the upgrade.
- No need to reconfigure services or API keys.
- No features were added or removed.
- Existing notes, recordings and folders are not moved, rewritten or deleted by the upgrade.
